fact: The Liberian team's Countdown to 2030 endline report, prepared for a workshop of 13 to 17 June 2022, states that facility reports are normally collected by the County Health Team on a monthly basis for entry into the national system DHIS2, and that 856 functional health facilities submit service delivery reports through DHIS2 against 964 on the Master Facility List.
title: Liberia: National and County Coverage on Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn & Child Health Data from Health Facility and Surveys information, Covering the period 2017-2021
